meta.name: gohighlevel
meta.description: Operate connected GoHighLevel CRM accounts through the NotFair MCP. Use for GoHighLevel, HighLevel, GHL contacts, conversations, opportunities, calendars, pipelines, tags, tasks, forms, invoices, products, or approved CRM changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 帮你查看并更新 CRM 里的客户、商机与日程安排
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果客户和商机都在 CRM 里,想直接对话式地查询和更新
copy.tagline_en: Look up and update CRM contacts, deals, and calendars through chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your contacts and deals live in a CRM and you want to update them by chat

howto.what: 通过 NotFair MCP 操作已连接的 GoHighLevel 账户:读取联系人、对话、商机、日历、地点等数据;只有你明确要求时才写入。改动前先列出地点、对象、现值与拟改值,执行后回读确认。
howto.when: 当你提到 GoHighLevel、GHL 等名称,或要查询、改动联系人、商机、日历等 CRM 数据时触发。连接缺失、未授权或对写入只读时,它会让你重新连接并停止。

say.text: 列出我 GHL 账户里最近的商机
给这个联系人加一个标签
帮我创建一个日历预约

howto.what_en: Operates connected GoHighLevel accounts via the NotFair MCP: reads contacts, conversations, opportunities and calendars, and writes only when you explicitly ask. Each change is shown first, then read back to confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention GoHighLevel, GHL or HighLevel, or ask about contacts, opportunities or calendars. If the connection is missing or read-only, it tells you to reconnect and stops.

say_en.text: List the recent opportunities in my GHL account
Add a tag to this contact
